##### Project general facts

Gardens of Eden - Eden Residence is a unique residential destination spanning a vast natural landscape, with the majority dedicated to beautiful parks, serene lakes, and lush gardens. The first phase, Eden Residences, features a collection of thoughtfully designed residences with soaring ceilings, private pools, sea-view terraces, inner gardens, and underground parking. Set within a car-free environment, this development redefines tropical living by seamlessly blending nature, privacy, and sophisticated design.

Residents enjoy an unparalleled array of world-class facilities. The destination includes five restaurants, six swimming pools, two kids' clubs, a wellness center, a business center, and a supermarket. Underground parking ensures a car-free, peaceful environment throughout the grounds. Every element is designed to support a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and leisurely resort living.

Each residence at Eden Residences is crafted with attention to detail and premium quality. Spacious layouts range from one-bedroom units to four-bedroom penthouses, many featuring private pools and expansive roof terraces. High ceilings create an airy sense of openness, while panoramic windows frame breathtaking sea and garden views. Kitchens are fully appointed, and interiors are finished in a contemporary style that balances elegance with tropical warmth, ready to welcome residents in complete comfort.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled just steps from Bang Tao Beach, this exceptional location places residents on one of Phuket’s most beautiful and sought-after coastlines. The area is renowned for its long stretch of golden sand, crystal-clear waters, and a refined atmosphere that attracts discerning travelers from around the world. The neighborhood offers a perfect balance of tranquility and accessibility, with lush natural surroundings enhancing the sense of escape.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and premium infrastructure. Phuket International Airport is within easy reach, while world-class shopping areas, gourmet grocery stores, boutiques, and international schools are just minutes away. Top entertainment and leisure destinations, including water parks and luxury resorts, are also close at hand, along with a reputable international hospital for peace of mind.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, convenience, and natural beauty, Bang Tao delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, five-star amenities, and strong international appeal makes it one of Phuket’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of island living, serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
